{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Aneth-Harvest.png]] |name=Aneth |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]]{{Databank|kellen|Kellen}} |pronouns=She/her |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Blonde]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners=[[Kellen]] {{C|[[Marriage|spouse]]}} |siblings= |children=[[Beela]] |affiliation=[[Mina-Rau General Store]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I can try again tonight.''"
"''We better wait.''"
"''She's just watching me all the time now.''"
"''Everyone's nervous.''"
"''My dad even tried and she wasn't having it.|Beela and Wilmon Paak discuss Aneth|audio=Beela-Wilmon-Aneth-SagronaTeema.flac|}} '''Aneth''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who owned and operated the [[Mina-Rau General Store]] on the [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]] with her [[Marriage|spouse]], [[Kellen]]. She disapproved of their daughter, [[Beela]], seeing the undocumented [[Technician|toolie]] [[Wilmon Paak]] and unsuccessfully urged her to stay away from him. In [[4 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire]] began an [[Imperial Supply Census]] of Mina-Rau and [[Krole's contingent|Imperials]] visited the store, making Aneth nervous. The next [[Local day|day]], they returned, and Aneth put on a false smile for Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]] when she spoke with him, although she sharply sent Beela inside when her daughter caught the lieutenant's [[eye]]. The Imperials then captured Paak's fellow toolie [[Brasso]] in front of the store and [[Death|killed]] him before being killed themselves by Paak and Brasso's ally [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]. ==Biography== ===Disapproving mother=== {{Quote|It's a long walk from the silos.''"
"''That's 'cause her mother doesn't like me coming around.''"
"''Why?''"
"''We're toolies.|Bix Caleen and Wilmon Paak discuss Beela and Aneth|audio=Bix-Wilmon-Toolies-OYL.flac|{{Andor|One Year Later}}}} [[File:Aneth-Kellen-Beela-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Aneth, Kellen, and Beela unpack various items onto the shelves inside the Mina-Rau General Store, while Aneth's P1 adminmech droid moves among them.|Aneth ran the Mina-Rau General Store with her spouse, Kellen, and their daughter, Beela.]] Aneth was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who owned{{Databank|beela|Beela}} and ran the [[Mina-Rau General Store]] with her [[Marriage|spouse]], [[Kellen]], on the agricultural [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]].{{Databank|mina-rau-general-store|Mina-Rau General Store}} The couple had a daughter, [[Beela]],{{Databank|beela|Beela}} who aided them in the shop alongside a [[Aneth's P1 adminmech droid|P1 adminmech droid]] that Aneth owned.{{Andor|Harvest}} {{AD|Disney+}} Between [[5 BBY]] and [[4 BBY]],The arrival of the "toolies" on [[Mina-Rau]] must have occurred after they leave [[Ferrix]] during the events of "[[Rix Road (episode)|Rix Road]]," which occur in [[5 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:AndorDate|here]]. It must also have occurred prior to their depiction on Mina-Rau during the events of "[[One Year Later]]," which dates itself to [[4 BBY]]. a group of undocumented [[Technician|toolies]] without [[visa]]s or shares on Mina-Rau illegally settled down nearby to carry out repairs and befriended Kellen. Beela became infatuated with [[Wilmon Paak]], a member of the group, but Aneth did not like him visiting her daughter at the store due to his illegal status and urged her to stay away from him. To get around this, Beela would often find excuses during the [[Local day|workday]] to bring [[water]] or supplies to Paak, who knew that Aneth disapproved of Beela seeing him. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Beela brought water to Paak and his friend [[Bix Caleen]] while they were working in one of the fields, prompting Paak to explain to Caleen that Aneth disliked his and Beela's relationship. ===The fears of a parent=== {{Quote|Did they remember the juice?''"
"''Finally.|Kellen and Aneth|audio=Kellen-Aneth-SagronaTeema.flac|}} [[File:Pyke-Aneth-SagronaTeema.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Aneth nervously handles some produce in the Mina-Rau General Store as Corporal Pyke stands nearby.|The Imperial inspections on Mina-Rau made Aneth nervous.]] The following [[Standard day|day]], a pallet of supplies was delivered to the store and Aneth, Kellen, and Beela unpacked it. Kellen asked Aneth if the suppliers had remembered to include juice, which Aneth confirmed they finally had. Kellen then left to speak with the toolies about an [[Imperial Supply Census]] that the [[Galactic Empire]] had begun carrying out on Mina-Rau. By this point, Beela felt that Aneth was watching her constantly but hoped to try and visit Wilmon Paak that night after her [[Parent|mother]] had stopped her in the past, having done the same when Kellen tried to visit the toolies. A [[Krole's contingent|group]] of the Imperials later arrived at the store while Kellen and Aneth were there, and Kellen spoke with them as they looked over the available goods. Aneth kept to herself and began picking up produce from the store's shelves, giving [[Brasso]]—one of the toolies who was in the store shopping—a nervous look. Later that night, Kellen visited the toolies to tell them what he knew about the Imperial inspections, as the toolies were keen to avoid being arrested should the inspections reach them. ===Fears realized=== {{Quote|There you are. Where's the boss?''"
"''He's at the silos.''"
"''I want these men fed. And, uh, save two meals. We'll be back in a bit.|Krole and Aneth|audio=Krole-Aneth-Harvest.flac|{{Andor|Harvest}}}} [[File:Aneth-Krole-Harvest.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Aneth stands out front of the Mina-Rau General Store as Imperial officers and stormtroopers move around her. In the foreground, Lieutenant Krole stands atop a troop transport.|Aneth greeted Lieutenant Krole when he arrived at her store.]] The Imperials returned the next day while Aneth was at the store alone, and she exited with the [[P1 adminmech droid]] to greet them. Outside she spotted [[Wilmon's speeder|Paak's speeder]], as he had come to say goodbye to Beela in the fields nearby before the toolies moved on to another area to avoid the Imperials. The Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]] asked Aneth where Kellen was and, after she told him that Kellen was at the [[Mega silo|silos]], ordered her to provide [[Foodstuff|food]] to his men and save two meals for him and [[Corporal]] [[Pyke (individual)|Pyke]], who would be returning in an [[Standard hour|hour]]. Krole then left [[Sergeant]] [[Stang (individual)|Stang]] in command of the Imperials at the store as Beela arrived back from the fields. Aneth then ordered Beela inside the store when she caught Krole's [[eye]], warning that she would not repeat the instruction when her daughter lingered. Brasso, who had returned to the store in search of Paak, was then captured by the Imperials and questioned in front of Kellen, who had also returned. In order to draw suspicion from Kellen and his family, Brasso accused him of turning in the toolies to the Imperials, which Stang fell for. Stang and several of the other Imperials at the store then left when Pyke called for aid over [[Comlink|comms]], but they were all [[Death|killed]] when [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]—a toolie who had been offworld—arrived in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] and [[Skirmish on Mina-Rau|fired]] on their [[Unidentified troop transport|troop transport]]. [[File:Kellen-Aneth-Harvest.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Kellen and Aneth stand together looking shocked in an entryway of the Mina-Rau General Store.|Aneth and Kellen watched in shock as Cassian Andor attacked the Imperials.]] Aneth and Kellen ran to the store's entryway to watch as Brasso used the opportunity to flee into the fields, with the remaining Imperials chasing after him. The Imperials killed Brasso and then perished themselves when Andor opened fire on them in the [[TIE series|TIE]], killing the final three by bursting a [[grain]] silo above them near the store. Andor, Paak, and Caleen then left Mina-Rau together in the Avenger. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Get inside. I won't tell you again.|Aneth, to Beela|audio=Aneth-GetInside-Harvest.flac|}} Aneth disapproved of her daughter Beela's relationship with Wilmon Paak due to his status as an undocumented toolie. She urged Beela to stay away from him and her daughter began to consider her overbearing, although Paak believed it was due to the nervousness that everyone was feeling on Mina-Rau during the Empire's inspections. [[File:Aneth-Beela-Harvest.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Beela stares sharply at Aneth on Mina-Rau, with grain fields and silos visible in the distance.|Aneth sharply ordered Beela inside when she caught Krole's eye.]] When Imperials did visit the general store, Aneth stayed quiet and was visibly nervous, although she greeted Lieutenant Krole with a fake smile when he spoke to her. After Beela caught Krole's eye, Aneth ordered her inside with an underlying sharpness in her voice despite the smile she still showed publicly. Aneth had light skin, [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]], and blue eyes. ==Equipment== Aneth wore a patterned red [[Clothing|shirt]] with a darker red dress under a brown apron with brown [[boot]]s. She owned a shabby P1 [[adminmech droid]] that helped in the store she owned with Kellen. ==Behind the scenes== Aneth was portrayed by [[Alison Pargeter]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in "[[Sagrona Teema]]" and "[[Harvest]]," the second and third episodes of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]], both of which aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]]. On the same day,{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} the character was also indirectly mentioned in the season's first episode, "[[One Year Later]]," and although the character's name was not spoken in any of the episodes, it appeared in the second- and third-episodes' credits. The exterior Mina-Rau scenes for ''Andor'' were filmed on the 007 Stage at [[Pinewood Studios]].{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-1|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 1 Trivia}} When [[Talia (Mina-Rau)|Talia]], another resident of Mina-Rau, received an entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]], it mistakenly used a photo of Aneth when it was originally posted on [[April 23]], 2025.{{Databank|talia|Talia|oldversion=20250423023621}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Aneth|imagecat=Images of Aneth}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{Imo}} *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Harvest}} ==Sources== *{{Databank|beela|Beela}} {{Imo}} *{{Databank|kellen|Kellen}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=アネス |ka=ანეთი }} [[Category:Business owners and executives]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Merchants]]
